provenance.license: Upstream license retained as SOURCE-LICENSE.txt; manufacturer photo rights remain separate.
provenance.sourcePolicy: Official CAD candidates are recorded independently in the model source audit; an uncalibrated model is not silently substituted for another SKU.
provenance.tessellation: Original STL triangle connectivity, source units not encoded; interpreted as mm and no rescaling.

limitations: 官方几何按固定仓库快照保存；只表示源文件实际提供的部分，不能据此推断完整硬件或固件支持。
未校准的显示位置使用独立 LIVE DEBUG 面板；真实屏幕上不会贴官方演示照片。
按键与内部电子器件只在另有来源时加入；未知板层明确标示 UNKNOWN。
原 STL 未写单位；尺寸与官方66×120×13.5 mm包络一致，按mm解释而不缩放。
四个 STL 的装配坐标保留；键帽为按壳体孔位和照片估计的补充，不冒充原 CAD。
显示/键盘调试仅对应V1.0 HD-V1-250326；不能从共用外壳推断V2电路兼容。
标记 DEBUG INPUT 的按键是独立调试控件，不表示已核实的实物按键位置。

debugPreview.reason: Official source geometry selected; scope, unit interpretation and omitted internals are declared.
debugPreview.controlPlacement: Separate labeled debugging controls where physical locations are uncalibrated; official physical matches are preserved.

representationScope: Official T-Deck Pro four-part enclosure at supplied assembly coordinates; missing keyboard keycaps are photo estimates. Runtime display/keyboard is explicitly the original V1.0 HD-V1-250326 board.

manualPhotoCalibration.method: Four STL files share assembled coordinates; rigid axis permutation only. 3.1in active panel centered within manufacturer front opening; missing keycap shapes estimated inside exact CAD holes. Key matrix identities are from V1.0 BSP.

dimensionChecks.basis: STL coordinate magnitudes agree with manufacturer mm dimensions; no scaling
